QuestInfo.name: [Hayato] Princess Sakuno's Gift
QuestInfo.0: A missive from Princess Sakuno arrives.
QuestInfo.1: A missive from Princess Sakuno arrives.
QuestInfo.2: Princess Sakuno sent Hayato some of her own mana, as well as some from Honnou-ji. With the princess's support, Hayato's power grew even further.
